name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge: with soft knees, push your hips back and lower the dumbbells down the front of your legs, then stand up by driving your hips forward.

source.title: Romanian Deadlift (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
cues: Push your hips back rather than bending your knees.
Keep your back flat and the weights close to your legs.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch, then stand up.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Weights in front of your thighs.

keyframes.name: Hinge
keyframes.cue: Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
